buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['index.html','styles.css','app.js'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) { if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(f,'public/'+f); } }); ['easyfact_logo.png','easyfact_icon.png','easyfact_hero.png'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f) && !fs.existsSync('public/'+f)) { fs.copyFileSync(f,'public/'+f); } });" && cd server && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
